milestones.title: A first planting
milestones.description: You sowed the first wildflowers in the forgotten garden.
milestones.hint: Open Plants and sow wildflower seeds in a sunny, open spot.

milestones.title: Signs of growth
milestones.description: Something you planted has begun to grow.
milestones.hint: Your seeds are settling in. Growth continues while you explore.

milestones.title: Clearing the way
milestones.description: You cleared some of the overgrowth.
milestones.hint: Open Restore and clear overgrown tiles. You'll find twigs and leaf litter underneath.

milestones.title: Gathering
milestones.description: You gathered natural materials from around the garden. You can now craft a natural shelter.
milestones.hint: Tap materials lying in the garden to gather them, or use Gather all.

milestones.title: A first visitor
milestones.description: A butterfly found its way to your flowers.
milestones.hint: Butterflies visit flowering plants. Give your wildflowers time to bloom.

milestones.title: A place to shelter
milestones.description: You built the garden's first natural shelter.
milestones.hint: Build a natural shelter from twigs, bark and leaf litter, ideally in a shaded corner.

milestones.title: First residents
milestones.description: Wildlife has moved into your shelter. You can now improve it.
milestones.hint: Shelters in shade, with plant cover nearby, attract residents sooner.

milestones.title: A garden restored
milestones.description: Three kinds of plant have grown to maturity. The forgotten garden is alive again.
milestones.hint: Grow three different kinds of plant to maturity.

completion.title: The forgotten garden is alive again
body: Flowers draw butterflies along the old paths, and small creatures shelter beneath the pines.
With a creak, the old gate in the north wall swings open. Beyond it, bamboo rustles in the wind: the Bamboo Grove is waiting.

completion.title: The grove breathes again
body: Light falls through the bamboo onto soft forest grass, and small creatures have found homes among the canes.
Somewhere beyond the grove, water is moving. The old wetland will be the next part of your sanctuary to wake.

milestones.title: Into the grove
milestones.description: You stepped through the gate and looked around the bamboo grove.
milestones.hint: Step through the open gate and take a look around the grove: tap anywhere inside it.

milestones.title: A way forward
milestones.description: You chose how to begin restoring the grove.
milestones.hint: Open Restore and choose how to begin restoring the grove.

milestones.title: Bamboo and understory
milestones.description: Young bamboo and shade plants are growing in the grove.
milestones.hint: Plant bamboo shoots and a couple of forest grasses or hostas in the grove.

milestones.title: Gathering canes
milestones.description: You harvested bamboo canes. Shelters can now grow in new directions.
milestones.hint: Tap a mature bamboo clump and harvest its canes.

milestones.title: A specialised refuge
milestones.description: You turned an improved shelter into a specialised home.
milestones.hint: Grow a shelter into a Mossy log lodge, then choose a direction for it.

milestones.title: A new arrival
milestones.description: A creature new to your sanctuary found its way to the grove.
milestones.hint: White-eyes visit established bamboo, and each specialised shelter draws its own residents.

milestones.title: The grove restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to restoring the grove.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

optional.title: A tree comes of age
optional.description: Your Japanese maple is fully grown. Its leaves and sap open new things to make.
optional.hint: A maple takes a few hours to mature; it keeps growing while you are away.

completion.title: The pond comes alive
body: Lilies float on clear water, reeds sway along the margin, and frogs call from the shallows.
Up the bank, beyond a low stone gate, a quiet garden of stone and moss waits to be found.

milestones.title: To the water
milestones.description: You stepped through the gate and looked around the old pond.
milestones.hint: Step through the grove’s north gate and take a look around the pond.

milestones.title: A plan for the pond
milestones.description: You chose how to begin restoring the pond.
milestones.hint: Open Restore and choose how to begin restoring the pond.

milestones.title: Planting by depth
milestones.description: Plants are growing in the water and along its edge.
milestones.hint: Plant lilies or hornwort out in the water, and reeds on the margin.

milestones.title: Dragonflies return
milestones.description: A dragonfly found a perch among the reeds.
milestones.hint: Dragonflies come once two reeds or rushes are fully grown.

milestones.title: Gathering reeds
milestones.description: You gathered reed stems. You can now build a frog shelter.
milestones.hint: Mature reeds shed stems; gather six.

milestones.title: A home by the water
milestones.description: You built a frog shelter by the pond.
milestones.hint: Build a frog shelter on damp ground beside the water.

milestones.title: Frogs arrive
milestones.description: A tree frog has come to the pond.
milestones.hint: Frogs come to a frog shelter once dragonflies or pond skaters are about.

milestones.title: The pond restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to restoring the pond.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: Stillness and life
body: Raked gravel, warm stones and soft lichen: the stone garden is calm again, and full of small lives in its crevices.
Through a mossy gate to the east, a damp hollow of ferns and fallen wood waits.

milestones.title: Among the stones
milestones.description: You looked around the old stone garden.
milestones.hint: Go through the pond’s north gate and take a look around the stone garden.

milestones.title: A quiet plan
milestones.description: You chose how to begin rebuilding the stone garden.
milestones.hint: Open Restore and choose how to begin rebuilding the stone garden.

milestones.title: Plants for dry ground
milestones.description: Thyme, fescue or lichen are growing among the stones.
milestones.hint: Plant thyme or fescue in sunny, dry spots, or lichen on gravel beside a stone.

milestones.title: Gathering stones
milestones.description: You gathered river stones. You can now build a rock pile and set stones.
milestones.hint: Clear the stone garden’s overgrowth to find river stones.

milestones.title: Warm stones
milestones.description: You built a rock pile in the sun.
milestones.hint: Build a rock pile on sunny, dry ground.

milestones.title: Small lives
milestones.description: Ants or spiders have made the stone garden their home.
milestones.hint: Ants nest in rock piles; jumping spiders bask on warm stones and thyme.

milestones.title: A lizard basks
milestones.description: A grass lizard has come to bask on the warm stones.
milestones.hint: Improve a rock pile into a sun-warmed cairn; lizards follow the small life there.

milestones.title: The stone garden restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to rebuilding the stone garden.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: The woodland floor
body: Ferns unfurl over soft logs, fungi return old wood to the soil, and the hollow’s leaf litter is alive with small workers.
East of the hollow, the trees open onto a sunlit meadow.

milestones.title: Into the hollow
milestones.description: You looked around the damp, shaded hollow.
milestones.hint: Go through the stone garden’s east gate and take a look around the hollow.

milestones.title: A plan for the hollow
milestones.description: You chose how to begin restoring the woodland floor.
milestones.hint: Open Restore and choose how to begin restoring the hollow.

milestones.title: Ferns in the shade
milestones.description: Royal ferns and wood sorrel are growing in the hollow.
milestones.hint: Plant royal ferns or wood sorrel in the deep shade.

milestones.title: Gathering deadwood
milestones.description: You gathered deadwood. You can now build a leaf-litter bed and log stacks.
milestones.hint: Clear the hollow’s overgrowth to find fallen wood.

milestones.title: A compost heap
milestones.description: You built a leaf-litter bed.
milestones.hint: Build a leaf-litter bed in the shade, then fill it with leaf litter.

milestones.title: Making leaf mould
milestones.description: Your leaf-litter bed made rich leaf mould.
milestones.hint: Fill the leaf-litter bed with leaf litter; it makes leaf mould while it is full.

milestones.title: Decomposers at work
milestones.description: Woodlice or millipedes have moved into the leaf bed.
milestones.hint: Woodlice and millipedes live in a leaf-litter bed in damp shade.

milestones.title: A toad appears
milestones.description: A toad has found the deep leaf litter.
milestones.hint: Improve the leaf-litter bed into a deep leaf bed; toads follow the woodlice and millipedes.

milestones.title: The hollow restored
milestones.description: You completed one approach to restoring the woodland floor.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.

completion.title: A meadow in bloom
body: Daisies, clover, asters and bellflowers sway in the long grass, and the air hums with many kinds of visitor.
To the south, past a gate by the meadow’s edge, you can hear running water.

milestones.title: Into the meadow
milestones.description: You looked around the open meadow.
milestones.hint: Go through the hollow’s east gate and take a look around the meadow.

milestones.title: A plan for the meadow
milestones.description: You chose how to begin sowing the meadow.
milestones.hint: Open Restore and choose how to begin sowing the meadow.

milestones.title: Sowing the meadow
milestones.description: Meadow flowers are growing in the sun.
milestones.hint: Sow three meadow flowers: clover, daisies, asters or bellflowers.

milestones.title: Many kinds
milestones.description: Four different species are growing in the meadow.
milestones.hint: Variety matters here: grow four different species in the meadow.

milestones.title: Hoverflies
milestones.description: Hoverflies came to the meadow’s mix of flowers.
milestones.hint: Hoverflies come where at least two kinds of flower are in bloom.

milestones.title: Gathering grass
milestones.description: You gathered grass stems. You can now build a bee bank.
milestones.hint: Grow tall meadow grass and gather five of its stems.

milestones.title: A bank for bees
milestones.description: You built a bee bank in the sun.
milestones.hint: Build a bee bank on sunny, dry ground.

milestones.title: A meadow visitor
milestones.description: A meadow specialist found its way here.
milestones.hint: Mining bees nest in a bee bank, grasshoppers sing from long grass, and a hawk-moth loves variety.

milestones.title: The meadow sown
milestones.description: You completed one approach to sowing the meadow.
milestones.hint: Finish both stages of your chosen approach in the Restore panel.
